name: Dryantore

attributes.attribute: Irish hero and giant who avenged his slain kin

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dryantore is an Irish hero and a giant. Fionn mac Cumhaill and the Fianna killed his three sons. They also killed the husband of his sister Ailna. Dryantore set out to punish the murderers. Ailna created a Druid’s Fog. The fog snared the warriors. Dryantore captured Fionn and the harper Dáire. He imprisoned them in his Otherworld palace. The remaining warriors found them and freed them. The giant’s vengeance drove the whole conflict. Dryantore died in the battle that followed.
